title: People Operations Lead
description:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home (40 hour week)
🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential.
✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered.
 We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!
 About the role
 We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.
 This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.
 You'll own our People operations, systems and data across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle - from onboarding, offboarding and Right to Work through to colleague requests, payroll processes, benefits and compliance. You'll make sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for ways to simplify, automate and improve them.
 Data is a big part of this role. We need someone who's genuinely at home in the numbers - happy getting into a complex spreadsheet, reconciling different data sources, spotting inconsistencies and using data to understand what's happening rather than simply reporting what it says.
 You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.
 And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

title: Senior Research Associate
description:
ABOUT MORE IN COMMON LOCATION:  London (Monday-Thursday in the office, Friday remote)
 CONTRACT:  Full-time
 SALARY: £36,000-£46,000
 START DATE: As soon as possible
More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges.
In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council.
Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues.
Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. title: Senior Quality Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Mission Brief

As part of the Quality team, the primary purpose of the role is to manage quality control activities and to work with production team to maintain product quality by enforcing quality management policies, procedures and instructions and implement new approaches. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Monitor the entire assembly, integration and testing cycle of launch vehicle (sub-) assemblies, plan and execute quality control activities, evaluate nonconformities, and specify corrective and preventive actions to solve the problems  

  • Conduct quality checks for ongoing works with site inspections on a regular basis and ensure that technical standards are always met

title: Account Executive, Enterprise Sales - DACH
description:
Pendo is hiring a Senior Account Executive for our Enterprise Sales team in Munich, Germany to drive new business across our largest DACH Accounts and Dax 40 prospect accounts. This role is built for high-performing enterprise sellers with a proven track record of closing $500K–$1M+ SaaS deals in start-up or high-growth environments.

You’ll lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, selling cutting-edge Data & Analytics solutions powered by AI—backed by exciting product innovation and momentum at Pendo—while accelerating growth in one of our most strategic segments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Win new enterprise logos across Germany within Pendo’s most strategic segment
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement to close
  • Consistently deliver $500K–$1M+ SaaS deals
  • Build trusted relationships with C-level and senior decision-makers
  • Develop and execute clear, strategic account plans
  • Position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics platform as a critical driver of digital transformation
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to win and expand strategic accounts
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline management

Experience & Requirements

  • Passion for AI and Technology - you'll be someone who embraces AI in and out of work, and a curiosity for AI and the role it is playing in all that we do
  • Strong track record of closing $500K–$1M+ enterprise SaaS deals across DACH 
  • Experience selling into large, complex, matrix organisations
  • Background in Data, Analytics, AI, or enterprise technology solutions
  • Proven success in a start-up or high-growth environment
  • Confident engaging senior stakeholders and executive buyers
  • Structured, strategic, and highly self-driven
  • Fluent German and professional English
